allowedSourceMaterial.overview: A widowed field mouse must move her family -- including an ailing son -- to escape a farmer's plow. Aided by a crow and a pack of superintelligent, escaped lab rats, the brave mother struggles to transplant her home to firmer ground.

facts.overview: A widowed field mouse must move her family -- including an ailing son -- to escape a farmer's plow. Aided by a crow and a pack of superintelligent, escaped lab rats, the brave mother struggles to transplant her home to firmer ground.
facts.title: The Secret of NIMH

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When ordinary field life collides with laboratory science, how will a desperate mother navigate the strange world of superintelligent rats?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: To save her ailing son before a farmer's plow destroys their home, a widowed field mouse ventures beyond safety, seeking help from a friendly crow and a secretive community of escaped, superintelligent lab rats.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, emotionally grounded family adventure with a dark speculative edge; moving and steadily paced.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Don Bluth weaves genuine dramatic stakes and sci-fi mystery into hand-drawn animation, creating an unusually atmospheric and suspenseful family adventure.
